commits_data.message:
packet-wps.c: Use explicit flag to show additional information

Rather than pass a NULL packet_info* if additional information isn't wanted (expert info and column data), make an explicit flag for it to ensure pinfo isn't NULL and can be used to replace wmem_packet_scope
